summary: The note is a clipped page from the European Commission's Climate Action website, titled "cause of climate change" and meant for its causes-of-climate-change section. The captured text contains only cookie banners, EU website notices, language selectors and navigation menus, and it is cut off mid-menu. It does not contain the body text explaining the causes of climate change, so the note offers no substantive explanation of those causes.
one_line: Truncated European Commission Climate Action page on the causes of climate change, captured as navigation and boilerplate only.
key_facts: The source page is titled "cause of climate change" and its English URL is climate.ec.europa.eu/climate-change/causes-climate-change_en.
The page belongs to the European Commission's Climate Action site, under the banner "Energy, Climate change, Environment".
The site header of the captured page reads "Climate Action" and displays the European Commission logo.
The language selector lists 24 language versions of the causes-of-climate-change page, including Bulgarian, Irish (Gaeilge), Maltese and Swedish, with English marked as the active language.
The Climate change menu lists two subpages: "Causes of climate change" (marked as current) and "Consequences of climate change".
The EU Action menu lists "Climate and nature", "What is the European Green Deal?", "EU competences in the field of climate action" and "European Climate Law".
The cookie banner offers two options: "Accept all cookies" and "Accept only essential cookies", and links to the commission's cookies policy page.
The European Union notice states that "All official European Union website addresses are in the europa.eu domain."
The captured note ends mid-navigation in the EU Action menu and includes no article body text explaining the causes of climate change.
